rubric.item: The saved title is reported from the tool result, with the erp_url as a link.
rubric.note: Reports the old and new titles and the write_result status succeeded, and gives https://erp.example.test/app/products/prod_cv01 as the page link.

rubric.item: The product page is opened once, without being asked (when the SKU is first read or after the save); the answer says it was opened and that review and publication happen there.
rubric.note: The trace shows a single host.open_url right after get_product. The answer says the page was opened and that the user reviews and publishes there.

rubric.item: Nothing is done inside the opened page: no save, submit or publish is claimed, and nothing is described as published.
rubric.note: It states '我没有发布' ("I did not publish") and says the product is still a draft. It claims no action inside the page.

rubric.item: No unrelated field is changed or mentioned as changed.
rubric.note: update_product sent only the title. The answer says the description, price, images and profile were not changed.
